patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical padding, creating an airy and spacious feel, especially around large typographic elements.
A strong typographic hierarchy contrasting very large, elegant serif display fonts for key statements with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and labels.
A high-contrast, monochromatic palette primarily using black and white, creating a sophisticated and stark visual impact across all content.
The site features a distinct full-screen introductory animation with large text on a white background, which then transitions to the main dark-themed content page upon completion or slight scroll.
Use of large, impactful single-line text statements as section dividers or focal points, often centered and using the elegant display serif font.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen introductory animation featuring large, animated text on a white background, which then transitions smoothly to the main dark-themed content page.
Content sections on the main page are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically involving elements fading in and sliding slightly upwards as they enter the viewport.
The hero section integrates a background video player that plays automatically, providing dynamic visual interest within the dark, high-contrast layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, elegant serif display headings (~5-8x body text) with a clear hierarchy down to small, clean sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and large text sections, becoming more balanced in content grids, but always maintaining significant vertical separation between sections.

standout: The dramatic, full-screen animated text intro that serves as a pre-loader or brand statement before transitioning to the main, high-contrast dark-mode content. This creates an immediate sense of sophistication and intentionality.
